title.es: Aquel del ataque de pánico en Mafinca
title.en: The One With the Panic Attack at Mafinca

description.es: Marta recibe la noticia de que la fábrica tendrá que trasladarse a Marruecos y lo comparte con Fina. Los recuerdos de los eventos sucedidos en Mafinca desatan en Fina un ataque de pánico, quien le pide desesperada a Marta que se vayan de allí
description.en: Marta receives the news that the factory will have to relocate to Morocco and shares it with Fina. The memories of the events that took place at Mafinca trigger a panic attack in Fina, who desperately begs Marta for them to leave that place.
